name: Accidentally Fated
original_name: 我不过作作妖！怎么就成白月光了
overview: Awakening as a “stupid and malicious” cannon-fodder, Jiang Huashan discovers she’s living in a scripted world. To save her adoptive grandfather, she rewinds time, defies the plot, and challenges the story’s rules—entangling herself with the three Shen heirs. In the end, she rewrites fate and chooses to stay in the world she has shaped.
